batting.dismissal: c DJ Hussey b PP Chawla

balls.text: full-toss and smacked over the bowler for a couple of runs, the long-on and long-off converge to get to the ball and by then they were off for a second
full-toss on his body and flicked away to the leg side for a single
very outside the off stump but not wide enough to be called a wide, Praveen Kumar has both his feet together and tries to swish away at it, misses
pushed down the ground for a single to long-on now, they need each of this run here
very full, on the off stump, flicked away to the leg side for a single
fuller and slower and driven down the ground for a single
fuller, faster and Praveen's able to play it back to the bowler, end of the 19th
on the middle stump, opens the face of the bat, through to the third-man for a single
outside the off stump and he wants to cut it away, misses it, too pacy for the batsman
flicked away to the leg side for a single
short of length, outside the off stump and he's not getting anywhere close to it, beaten

bowled him! gone, bowled, what a collapse, and again! he was looking to play it over the off side, the ball was too quick there and he misses it, crashes into the middle and about one-tenth of a second later it's lying flat on the ground.
oh yes, hat-trick, team hat-trick for Hyderabad! it was a wrong 'un and that's been slogged away to Ishant Sharma at deep mid-wicket!
gone, run-out! on his pads, on a length and he looks to flick it, gets a single and wants to come back for the second run, there was no such availability and he's run-out without facing a ball!
but now he's caught, Mishra gets a wicket! it was fuller, on the leg stump, Mahmood had to go for it but does not time it too well and he's caught at long-on!
smash, four! it was fuller on the off stump and drilled over the extra-cover region for a four, in the gap between the sweeper and long-off, too much width
was looking to slog it away this time, it spins away from him, beats his bat, hits the back pad and gets him a single leg bye
swept away behind square and gone for a four, that's good batting, chosen the field well
and almost an outside edge, beaten, misses it through to the keeper
short of a good length but on the middle stump and he has to defend it back to the bowler
opens the face of the bat and gets it through backward point for a single to deep third-man

gone, caught on the second attempt! tries to hit Ishant out of the ground, sliced it a tad more than he would have liked and it went straight to Akshat who fumbles with it before grabbing it on the second attempt
it was on a length but keeps a tad low, flicked away to the leg side for a single
down the pitch and he was looking to clear the off side, on the bounce to the sweeper fielder
googly, beats the bat by a mile but that was going down the leg side too, the appeal is quickly quietened by the ump
driven down the ground for a single for Hussey now
flicked away for a single to the leg side
and he goes down the track for a six! he was going down the track and was not looking to hit it very hard, just chipping it, just over long-on for maximum
on the leg stump and he was able to tap it away for a single
fuller outside the off stump and swept away to the deep square-leg for a single
shorter, quicker, on the middle stump, tapped away to the leg side for a single, wanted a second but gets back to his crease
a back of the hand slower ball and it's driven down the ground for a single
shortish from the bowler and outside the off stump, wanted to crack it away but hits it straight to the point fielder
short of length from Perera, pushes it to the off side and is off for a quick single, misfield allows them to complete it very easily
slower one now and driven down to the long-on for a single

gone, run-out! he was looking to play his favourite pull shot, the ball did not seem to come on to the bat and he had to try and hit it very hard, that pushes him further to the back foot which meant that he fails to get to the other end in time before the throw came in, good hand from the leggie
on a good length and driven to the off side, straight to the off side
fullish from the bowler, looks to play it through mid-wicket but straight to the fielder
shorter and slower, opens the face of the bat and taps it to the point region for a single
another bouncer, another one that beats the flaying bat of Chawla, it did not come on too well, fortunately for the batting team, it's a wide
bouncer, swings it across the line, misses, not finding it easy to play the bouncers here Chawla
slower one from Ishant, tad fuller too and pushed through the covers for a single
if Chawla can do it, so can I is what Hussey is saying here, he digs it in short and that's timed it cleanly over the mid-wicket fence for a six!
three in a row and this time Chawla's waiting for it, he's able to crash it through mid-wicket for a quickly taken couple of runs
beaten again, another slower one and a tad wider too, looking to go down and cut it away, misses the outside edge of the bat
bouncer and it does not come on too quickly on the bat, this time it is a sub 125 km/hr delivery alright and he's beaten
a near bouncer, I thought it was a slower one too but the speed gun shows 135.3 km/hr, the ball does not come on and he's able to tap it to the leg side
shorter this time and he was trying to push it through the covers, goes straight to the fielder at the covers
short of length and on the middle stump, tapped away to the leg side but not for a run
ooh, a googly there and beats the outside edge of Chawla's bat who does not read it
down the ground again from Chawla and smacked, on the bounce for a four! he's turned it on here!
fullish outside the off stump and he's able to play it down the ground, for a single to long-off
fuller, tapped away to the leg side but not for a single
fullish from the bowler, he was looking to paddle it away but does not get it off the middle, gets a single to the short fine-leg for a single
fuller and driven to the off side for a single
a googly this time, he was looking to play against the spin, gets an inside edge to the leg side for a single
fuller and driven back to the bowler, not for runs
shorter from the bowler and Chawla is able to flick it away to the leg side for a single
whoa, that's second six and he's walked down the track and smashed it over the bowler's head for another maximum, suddenly it looks like it's not been such a bad move!
short of length and pushed it back to the bowler who runs to his left and fields
a very clean strike to one that's pitched very up to him, swept over the deep square-leg for a six!
bouncer that takes off, it looked to be going over the batsman who lets it go, Hussey was looking for a wide there but not given
whoa, quick, beaten for pace, 143.4 km/hr and through to the keeper
inside edge for a four! that could have gone anywhere, to the keeper, on to the stumps and to the fence, the ball chose the latter option and helps Punjab get four more to their score
another one that's aimed to cramp Chawla up and it's another quicker one, the batsman's on to his back foot and flicks it to square-leg for a single, two in two for him, so far so good!
short of length on the off stump and he's played it away through the covers for a single, was looking to come back for the second but Chawla sends him back
short of length and flicked away by Chawla to fine-leg for a single, that was a quick one too

very full and that's been hit straight to the fielder, gone! that was a poor shot from someone who's taken 17 balls to get his eye in, it was full and he tried to hit it over the fielder at long-on, does not get it properly off the middle and it lobs up gently to the long-off fielder who takes it as easily as Ishant took the previous catch, gone!
shorter and spinning away, tapped to the deep cover fielder for a single

gone, caught at deep mid-wicket! that was shorter in length but the turn seems to have done him in, he was looking to pull it over the fielder but this is a difficult to pitch to do that against the slower bowlers, straight to Ishant, who looks like he barely moved an inch to catch it
tries to guide it through third-man but that's slower and it unable to use the pace of the ball
tries to force it off the back foot but does not get it off the middle, goes on the bounce to long-off for a single
shorter, quicker and Gilly is able to go back and tap it to the off side, there's a good effort but a bit of a misfield in the end allows him to come around for a single
slightly shorter but some turn back into Gilly who plays it down the ground for a single to long-off
swept away this time because it was on his pads and full, goes to fine-leg for a single
fuller from Mishra and on a good line too, he has no option but to defend on the front foot
slows it up well and it's defended to the off side
fuller and on the middle stump, driven down the ground for a single
shorter, flatter and not too much turn, goes straight on and hit back to the bowler
and now four byes because of the extra turn, spun across the bat again and he was looking to drive at it, he missed, the keeper missed but the scorer does not, adds four byes to the total
a sweep this time, he is able to get some bat on it and they are off for a second run, Steyn has a good arm but the throw isn't accurate enough or he could well have been run-out
and some more turn! that was shorter in length and he was looking to tap it away to the off side but beaten again!
quicker, flatter and defended to the leg side, three dots now
and a lot of turn this time, he was looking to defend it off the front foot and was miles away from the bat after it spun
slowish, turning away from the bat, beats the outside edge
shortish in length on the off stump and he is able to push it to mid-on and scamper off for a quick single there
short of length but closer to the batsman, who opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third-man for a single
short of length and wanted to cut it again, pity he does not get any bat on it, goes through to the keeper
slashes hard and for a four! that's his favourite shot and he's not been hitting those earlier this tournament, this time he does, short, wide and cut hard to the fence
fullish from Ishant and played away to square-leg where it's fielded by Vihari who throws it at the non-striker's end, hits the stumps and the ricochet gets him an overthrow
short of length, outside the off stump and that's defended to the off side

shorter and slower and the pull shot is not hit as well as he would have liked, goes to the fielder who throws it back to the non-striker's end, Valthaty was out of his crease and just gets back in time
a slower ball this time, it did not come on to the bat this time, was looking to pull it away but hits the bottom of the bat
make it three fours in four balls, it's on a length and Gilly bludgeons it between mid-on and mid-wicket inside the circle, cracked it, absolutely cracked it
whoa, that's not a shot of a batsman not in form! it was a length ball and Gilly clears his foot slightly, and whacks it over mid-wicket for a four, second in the over
a tad slower from Perera and he opens the face of the bat but is not able to work it away to the off side properly, to the fielder
brilliant shot, short of length and cut hard, through the covers and for a four! that had some width for him and he went after it
and that's a pretty ordinary shot, 146 km/hr, on a length and Valthaty was looking to walk through it, he missed the bat by a distance and it goes through to the keeper
fuller from Steyn and defended to the off side by Valthaty, played well that one
bouncer from Steyn, 147.6 km/hr, really quick and Valthaty lets it go, that was a bit wide outside the off, allowed him to sway away easily
shorter from Steyn and the pull is a bit of a mis-hit, goes straight to Mishra at short fine-leg, and he misfields! It was as straightforward as they come and he missed it
ooh, he was trying to drill it through the covers there, as he got some width from Steyn, so far he was very close to the stumps but not that time, misses, through to the keeper
fuller from Steyn this time but Gilly's sitting on his back foot and is able to still play it away to the off side
length ball that rises disconcertingly at the batsman, who is able to tap it away to the leg side for a quick one

top-edge and caught! that was a short of length ball and he was trying to pull it away, was in an aggressive mood tonight but that brings about his downfall too, the ball gets his top edge and it goes high, swirls away from the keeper de Kock who runs towards the third-man region to catch it well
another flick and and another couple of runs, was a quick enough delivery but Mandeep was equal to it, it was in the air for some time. Mishra gave chase but wasn't able to restrict it to one
was moving away to the leg side there, Ishant follows him and tries to cramp him up, but he's able to flick it away in front of square-leg for a couple of runs
short of length from Ishant yet again and Mandeep looks to whip it across the line, goes to mid-on
down the leg side, on his pads and a tickle on it would have taken it to the fence, instead it's a wide called
short of length and he picks up the length very early, pulled away to the deep square-leg region for a four!

another short of length delivery from Steyn and Gilchrist pulls it well again, this is in front of square and the fielder has to run around from deep square leg to stop it, was racing away, restricted to two
short of length on the off stump and pushed to the mid-off region where Ishant fields and fires it back in, does not hit but Mandy was in as it is
out-swinger for Mandeep and he lets it go through to the keeper, not the aggression this time that was on display in the first over
shortish and Gilly unleashes a very quick pull, short arm jab almost but goes straight to the long-leg fielder and they get a single, it whizzed off the bat
another in-swinger into the left-hander, nice curve back in and Gilly is very, very watchful, pushes it to the covers
in swinger first up and it's fullish as well, Gilly's playing him off the back foot, defended to the off side
and now the reverse sweep from Mandy which does not hit the bat, an excited wicket-keeper goes up in appeal, almost
hits his pads, off an inside edge and there was a stifled appeal for lbw, given not-out
fuller from the bowler, Gilly has bat and pad out and pushes it back to the bowler
goes down the pitch and drives it down to long-on for a single
oooh, beaten, wanted to go across the line, doesn't connect
slow from round the wicket, driven back and almost carries
you got to be kidding me, what a way to end the game, third six in a row to make it five wins in seven games and catapult to the top of the points table!
gone again and that's one of the biggest sixes you would see on a track like this, it was on a length and it's been cracked over the mid-wicket region for a six! what a shot!
slower ball but very full, almost an attempted leg-spinner, driven down the ground for a single
and again, was looking to explode over the bowler's head but this time he is almost beaten, over the bowler's head for a single
bouncer from Mahmood and he was looking to duck, called a wide and Gilly is not happy! talking to the umpire too but he isn't going to change that!
gone for a six! fuller from him and Perera has opened his stance and knocked it over the long-on region for a six! that's a deal-clincher!
slower one from Gony and he has to check his stroke there, taps it back to the bowler
short of length and was looking to hook it away, dragged it a little because of the pace but in the end it beats the long-on fielder, Chawla and it eludes him well enough to get him a four!

smashed and what a shot, but not for a run! it was hit hard down to mid-on and a yard either side would have gone through to the fence, goes to hand and Hussey throws it to the non-striker's end, hits the stumps too but Perera is back home
looks to hoick it away over mid-wicket, one of his favourite, clear-his-foot-and-hit stroke, gets only an inside edge
looks to play it through the leg side but gets only an inside edge on to his pads and it rolls over to the on side for a single
short of length and there was extra bounce on that one, beats the cut stroke that he was attempting, outside edge goes down to third-man
he was swinging that like it was a game of golf, misses it by a mile too and through to the keeper, 25 needed from the last three overs
slower on the off stump and driven down the ground for a single, well bowled this
122.5 km/hr but cramping the batsmen for room, he is only able to tap it away to the off side, not for runs though
fullish outside the off and he looks to drive it through the covers, the ball does not quite come on to the bat and goes to the short cover fielder
fuller on the middle stump and he's able to flick it away to fine-leg for a single

appeal for an lbw and given! was looking to play it through the leg side, missed and hits the back pad, still to ascertain whether it was hitting outside the off stump but otherwise looks close enough
and another one that keeps low and beats the batsman, beats the keeper, beats the stumps and then the fielder at fine-leg, four byes to help take some pressure off!
fuller and slower, well thought by the bowler, he plays it well too, opens the face of the bat down to third-man for a single
bouncer and this time there's no bat on it, gets the batsman trying to hook it away, misses
opens the face of the bat and guides it through the point region for a four! wow, what a shot, pure timing!
off the mark by guiding it down to third-man for a single to get off the mark

bowled him, keeps low! it was on the stumps and White was playing off the back foot, the ball kept really low and it's gone through the batsman and stabbed the stumps down, four down and this gets interesting now
opens the face of the bat through to the off side for a single to signal the time-out
bit more flight from the bowler, was looking for an expansive shot, but can get it away to the long-on region for a single
tapped away to the off side for a single again, they are doing it easily here
tries to slog it away but the ball was a lot slower than he expected and is beaten there, stumping appeal too but well in
very full, on the middle stump and tapped to the off side for another one
flighted ball and driven down to the long-off region for a single
and another one attempted, and even ruffles White up a little here but the non-striker is quick to call him across for a single
and this time the bouncer gets high enough which is pulled away to the very fine, fine-leg for a four! well controlled shot there!
short of a length from Gony now and opens the face of the bat to third-man
short of length and a shot in anger at last, cracked through the covers for a single only
beaten! it was a good length ball again and the ball seems to have nipped away from the batsman, White was looking to move around in the crease but is beaten
quicker from Gony and on the middle stump, on a good length, defended back to the bowler
length ball on the off stump and he looks to open the face of the bat, gets it away to the point fielder, five singles in that over
fullish on the middle and easily tapped down to long-on for a single
oh ho, the ball keeps low there and almost gets the inside edge, rolls over to the leg side for a single
short of a length, slower too and wanted to pull it away to the deep square-leg region for a single
opens the face of the bat and guides it to the third-man for a single
fuller on the middle stump and pushed to mid-on where Chawla dives to his left and it's misfielded
opens the face of the bat, gets it away to the off side but not for runs
fuller from the bowler and turned away to the leg side now

out, caught at short cover! I am tempted to say that it's a poor shot but let's give it to the bowler, flighted it a tad and outside the off stump, he was looking to drive it down the ground but gets some more elevation than he would have liked and it goes straight to the extra-cover fielder who takes a simple one
fuller on the leg stump, was looking to play it away to the leg side, gets a leading edge to the off side
comes forward, bends down, turns it down to the leg side and jogs across for an easy run
drives down the ground to wide long-on for a couple, that's easily done, easy runs on what's said to be a difficult pitch
misses his line a little, but the length is good and he's able to tuck it away to the square-leg for a single
on the off stump and he's played it away to the leg side for a single
short of length and taps it to deep square-leg for a single
flicked away to the leg side, again the same line and length and easily played away

whoa, good diving effort from Valthaty but in the end it goes for a four, it was on the middle stump and he was looking to short-arm pull it over the square-leg region, dived to his right but just eludes him
short of length, White was moving around in his crease and in the end he opens the blade and guides it to deep point.
shorter outside the off stump and defended back to the bowler, ends it better than he started it
fuller on the off stump and gets the drive out, down to long-off for a single
outside the off stump and turns slightly away, misses the outside edge and is beaten
fuller on the middle stump and driven to the leg side for a single
slower, turned away and opens the face of the bat through to the point fielder
goes over the top and hits it to the left of long-off for a four, hit with the turn and the room allows him to play it away for a four
fuller from him this time and White defends it back to the bowler to end a very good over
same line and length and the defensive stroke goes to the off side
on a length and on the off stump line, making the batsman hit it across, only pushes it to the off side
opens the face of the bat now and plays it down to third-man for a single
middle stump line now and he is able to work it away down the ground for a single
on the off stump and on a length, gets a lot of bounce on that one and taps it to the point fielder
fuller in length and he pushes it to the off side

what a stunner, Mahmood, you beauty! it was fuller on the off stump and he was looking to go over the mid-off fielder, it looked like he had chosen the right shot too and had almost gone past the fielder, but Mahmood puts his hand out and plucks it out of thin air, that's a ripper!
short of length and on the off stump, tapped it away to the off side for a single
up and over the mid-on fielder and for a four, it was very full from Gony and executed well by the batsman, chipped over the the in-fielder
133.7 km/hr, on the off stump, he's on the back foot and defending there
on the length outside the off stump, easily played away to third-man for a single
and a lot of slow turn again, but easily negotiated away to the off side for one
cut away and four! it was very short from Chawla and he is able to cut hard, beats the backward point fielder very easily and it goes away to the fence
outside the off and he gets his knee down and paddles it to fine-leg for a four, good effort from Mascarenhas but does not stop it quickly enough
fuller, on the off stump and this time gets it on the bat but drives to the short cover
spin, and he was looking to defend on the front foot, beats the outside edge!
fuller on the off stump and he gets his bat and pad out, drives it down the ground for a single
looking to play it over the in-field there by coming down the track, smacks it to Gony at mid-on who fields it well by diving to his left
this is too straight and he's easily tucked away to the leg side for a couple of runs through mid-wicket
length ball on the middle stump and pushed into the covers, not for runs though
short of length, on the middle stump and punched down to mid-on for a single
was looking to play it through the leg side, wanted to flick it away but hits an inside edge on to the pads and trickles to the leg side
very full, half-volley length outside the off stump and easily crashed through the covers for a four!
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and wants to guide it to third-man but gets only to point, better from Hyderabad
again on a length and they are pinching the runs inside the circle quite easily, dabbed to the covers and away they are!
shorter from PK and that's pulled away to deep square-leg for a single this time
short of length on the off stump, punched through the covers for three more runs, that's excellent running!
up and over! it was a short of length ball and at his pace it was easy picking, he looked like he wanted to play it over third-man but adjusted the shot well to hit it through the covers
moves down the track and taps it to the off side, hares across for a single
a good length ball which is played away to the off side, not for runs though to end a good over

whoa, almost lbw, whoa ,almost a four! it was on the middle stump and almost creeps up to the batsman, had he missed it would have been curtains but had he got a thicker edge, could have beaten the short fine-leg
makes room for himself and finds the gap through the covers for a couple of runs
bit of a wristy flick to one on the off stump, rolls down to long-on for a single
on the off stump and pushed into the covers, they go for a quick one to Hussey who shies at the striker's end, but he's in
short of length on the off stump and tapped back to the bowler, nice tight bowling from Punjab
quicker from PK, bit of bounce, and swing away from the batsman and beats the outside the edge
slower one from PK and it's flicked away to David Hussey who's at square-leg and miked up with the commentators, misses a direct hit, was out had it hit!
on the middle stump and flicked it away behind deep square-leg for a couple of runs, well played, gap found well
length ball that is pushed to the mid-on region, something might give here, one of them might look to take PK on
on a length on the off stump and defended back to the bowler, not too much happening off the bat off his bowling
another keeps very low, but no swing on that one, it's on the off stump and defended it to the leg side
heaved away over mid-wicket for a four! that was fuller and the batsman did not have too much hesitation in going over the top there
short of length and not too much pace on it, pats it to the mid-wicket region for a single
fuller on the middle stump, coming back into the batsman who pushes it to the mid-wicket region for a single
on the middle stump, gets some bounce on it and is able to flick it away to the leg side for a single
short of length, on the off stump, pushed it to the off side
ooh, keeps very low, on the off stump and he was going back to play at it, gets the bottom half of the bat and is able to play it away to the leg side
on a good length and on the a good line too, off stumpish and it's defended back to the bowler for no run
on the off stump, not too much swing there and defended back to the bowler

bowled him, PK has the middle stump castled! that was coming back into the batsman and he was looking to flick it away to the leg side, gets bit of a pad and then rocks the middle pole back, gone for a duck
outside the off stump and he wants to cut it, it looked like the ball did not come on to the bat, digs it hard into the ground through to the point fielder
this time he gets the swing from close to the stumps, swing away too and defended back to the bowler
outside the off and some movement away from the leg-hander, he was looking to play at it before opting out of the shot
